Welcome to Apple Valley Creamery!

Apple Valley Creamery stewards God's resources as a trusted source for inspiration, influence, and information to enrich, educate, and nurture individuals, families, and communities.

GET STARTED
1. Sign Up

Sign up for home delivery and we will let you know what day of the week we are in your neighborhood.

2. Order

Make your order and choose if you want it to be a one-time order or a recurring order.

3. Enjoy

Eagerly wait for your delivery person to arrive.

Why Apple Valley?
We are family owned and operated.
We are open and transparent.
We are here to connect you to our family farm.

Apple Valley Creamery milk is all-natural and healthy for you and your family.  Our cows are not given the rBST hormone injection and are grass-fed.  Milk from grass-fed cows is healthier because it contains more cancer fighting agents than milk from cows that are not allowed to graze.  Read more about our cows and our farm under the "farming practices" page located on our homepage.  You can also be pleased to know that we are independently audited by the Animal Welfare Approved program to meet all of their standards for our dairy farm.

FARM STORE& TOURS

We encourage you to visit our creamery and farm store during store hours or contact us to schedule a private or group tour of our farm and creamery.  As opposed to many commercial farms, we welcome cameras and questions; we are proud of what we do here and want you to see it!  

Store Hours:
Tuesday - Saturday 10:00AM - 6:00PM
Closed Sunday and Monday

Closed on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day.

Apple Valley Creamery's farm and facilities are available for tours, and we love to do them!  You can always view our creamery through the viewing windows in our store, during store hours.  If you want a more in-depth tour, then a guided farm tour may be for you.  The guided farm tours run from April 1st through November 30th.  Tours spotlight farm animals, food production, and farm life.  Your family or group will be able to experience daily farm life firsthand.  While on a farm tour, plan to meet different animals and see how the milk goes from the cow to your breakfast table. 

Tours can also include the following, based on the day and time of day you come:

Demonstrations of our bottling process: Schedule a tour on a day that we are bottling our milk to see the entire process through our large viewing windows.

Demonstrations of our milking process: Schedule a tour during our 4:00 - 5:00 pm afternoon milking time to see how the milk is harvested from our cows.

TOUR PRICES ARE:

CHILDREN UNDER AGE 2 - FREE (PROVIDED THEY DO NOT WANT TO RECEIVE A GOODIE BAG)*

AGE 2 - ADULT - $5.00 PER PERSON (A GOODIE BAG IS INCLUDED FOR THE CHILDREN.)*

A minimum of 10 paying people are required (or a minimum fee of $50.00).

* A goodie bag may include one or more of the following:  "got milk" pencils, cow shaped erasers, cow themed bracelets and coloring/sticker books. 

Please contact Sharon to schedule your group tour, sharon@applevalleycreamery.com.  

FURTHER FARM TOUR INFORMATION

We are a REAL working dairy farm.  As such, we have a variety of equipment, animals and areas which require your attention and respect. Some of these are open to you, while others are private. As we open our farm to you (and those in your group), we will assign a primary contact person to act as your guide. Please direct all questions and concerns to your guide and follow all instructions accurately. We expect you to stay with the tour guide at all times, be attentive, stay together, follow directions and act responsibly at our farm. 

In visiting the farm, children are required to have reasonable adult supervision (parent or guardian, teacher, chaperone, or supervisor) to safely and effectively manage everyone in your group.  While we do not mandate what reasonable adult supervision should be, we reserve the right to determine when something represents a problem for us or others, and to take corrective action, including ending a tour or asking someone to leave. You (as an adult, parent or supervisor) need to keep all children close at hand, oversee their activities at all times and watch for their safety around others, our buildings, and active and stationary farm equipment.

We work hard to provide and maintain a clean and safe environment at our farm, including several hand wash stations.  However, you are responsible to ensure that any children in your group wash their hands after touching or feeding animals before they eat any food or snacks. 

Photographs are permitted but are not allowed to be sold or used in any way without our written permission.

ABOUT US
Who We Are

Apple Valley Creamery is a small dairy farm and creamery located in East Berlin, Pennsylvania.  This sixth-generation farm has been in the Stoner family since 1928.  Hard work and perseverance led to the growth of the farm and the establishment of Apple Valley Creamery in 2005.  We are dedicated to being good stewards of the resources God has given to us so that we can pass our family farm on to future generations.  Apple Valley Creamery is currently owned and operated by Larry & Sharon Stoner and their family.

What We Do

Apple Valley Creamery is here to connect you and your family to our family farm.  We are dedicated to producing all-natural, premium dairy products and beef.  We have a large selection of milk in returnable glass bottles, which can be purchased at our farm store, through home delivery, or at local markets and stores.  We also sell products from many other local farms and businesses.

Our Promise to You

Our wholesome products are the result of our passion to provide only the best for our cows.  We are independently certified by the "Animal Welfare Approved" program.  Consumer Reports state, "Animal Welfare Approved is a highly meaningful label, backed by the standards that are strong, verifiable, and comprehensive in addressing animal welfare for farm animals."  In addition, Apple Valley Creamery only plants and feeds non-genetically modified crops.

We are your trusted farmers, committed to getting fresh food to your door.
